phases.objective: Allow SkipBuild to reuse an already verified exact Staging image while preserving fail-closed provenance validation and requiring live Staging certification before merge.

e2e_journeys.actor: Governed CI and the local Staging operator
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Run the Staging post-build image discovery contract against the exact PR head after an exact image has already been discovered.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Smart and SkipBuild modes may reuse only an exact provenance-matching image, while SkipBuild still fails closed when no exact image exists and Production remains untouched.
steps: Resolve an existing image through the governed exact-provenance discovery path and verify commit, tree, context file-set, and secrets-included labels.
Evaluate the build-mode decision so Smart and SkipBuild can reuse the verified image before the SkipBuild missing-image failure branch.
Run the Windows PowerShell 5.1 image-reuse regression coverage and retain live Staging certification as a required non-production follow-up.
assertions: SkipBuild exact-image reuse is evaluated before its fail-closed missing-image branch.
The old Smart-only reuse condition is absent.
Exact commit, tree, context file-set, and secrets-included=false provenance checks remain unchanged.
A missing or non-exact image still fails closed.
Live Staging certification remains required before merge.
This critical E2E declaration is registered exactly in Constitution.control_plane_paths and convergence.automation_control_paths.
No Production deployment, Production mutation, provider mutation, database mutation, or secret exposure is introduced.
